rename.resolution: Retracted 2026-09-04: the name already agrees. No code change, and no target name invented.

why:
RETRACTED as a rename 2026-09-04; see `cpp:create_client` for the shared cause (issue 0818's `#ifdef NROS_CPP_STD` blind spot). `nros::create_service` existed at `std_compat.hpp:138`, in the since-DELETED header, and `Node::create_service<S>` at `node.hpp:449`/`:467`; `make_service` exists nowhere.

One structural difference beyond the client's: rclcpp's free `create_service` REQUIRES a `CallbackT&&` (six required parameters), while our free form is poll-style and the callback form is the member overload at `node.hpp:467`.

phase-442 W2 (2026-09-11) — `std_compat.hpp` is DELETED, so any sentence above naming that header describes a spelling that no longer exists. It was a third orphaned vocabulary: free functions shadowing the `Node` methods a ported file calls, dead in every shipping configuration, and RFC-0096 removed the layer it belonged to. The always-available spelling is the method.
